raw.body: Since moving to https://github.com/react/react from https://github.com/facebook/react, I noticed that the CI is not running ci/codesandbox job to create the branch build of React for creating sandboxes. Looking at Codesandbox, the last build was about a week ago https://ci.codesandbox.io/status/facebook/react/pr/36724 When I go to codesandbox for react/react, I am getting a not set up error: https://ci.codesandbox.io/status/react/react/pr/36724 React version: https://github.com/react/react repo (as of 6/16/2026) ## Steps To Reproduce 1. Open a PR that would update React DOM or React. 2. Have the CI run the initial 4 basic checks, but only get 3 Link to code example: ## The current behavior Here is an example of a pr without the ci/sandbox job #36805 ## The expected behavior Here is the last pr to have the ci/sandbox job #36711
raw.title: Bug: [CI] ci/codesandbox job not running since moving react to react org
